palette_provenance: Not project-native: the creator's brand (Solaris blue, hue ~200) and Claude terracotta (hue ~9) both fall inside the color anti-repeat exclusion zone this run. A green terminal (mono-terminal) shipped on 2026-06-23, so to honor the aesthetic anti-repeat AND the operator's sameness note, chose a custom violet 'AI-perception' console -- the color of a model seeing -- built on the subway-chrome base (JetBrains Mono display + Inter body, fade register, electronic bed). Accent violet hue ~266 sits >= 60 off both recent accents (07-05 warm 9, 07-06 cool 200). Canvas lifted to luma ~49 (dark slate-violet, not near-black) so the frame clears the brightness floor by design.

readability.accent_ink_note: renderer derives --accent-ink (violet blended to ~205 luma) for text-scale accent; raw #B074FF kept for dots/fills/glows.
readability.muted_content_note: activity/detail lines use --muted-content; raw ink_muted only for decorative tags.
per_scene_light_source: s1 screen_capture: accent-ink lead line in the window
s2 terminal: bright typed command on dark frame
s3 montage: 12 bright tiles (the light source)
s4 panes: bright status names + state dots
s5 screen_capture money: bright grounded answer, accent-ink lead
s7 flash: full violet field (brightest beat)
inverted_beats: s7 flash (bright violet field, dark ink)
readability.brightness_plan: Canvas luma ~49 keeps the overall frame mean above the 46 floor by construction; the mosaic and the flash are the two planned bright beats (a color script, not a grade lift).
readability.color_anti_repeat: accent hue ~266 vs 07-05 (#ff7a61 hue 9, warm) and 07-06 (#1fb6ff hue 200, cool): >= 60 off both AND large delta-E; distinct from the 06-23 green terminal too.
